containerDefinitions.name: blogsync
command: set -e; : "${SQL_URL:?pass the presigned S3 URL as SQL_URL in containerOverrides}"; DSN=$(printf '%s' "$DIRECT_URL" | sed -e 's/schema=public&//' -e 's/[?&]schema=public//'); wget -qO /tmp/blog-sync.sql "$SQL_URL"; echo "[blogsync] fetched $(wc -c < /tmp/blog-sync.sql) bytes"; psql "$DSN" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /tmp/blog-sync.sql; echo '[blogsync] categories then posts:'; psql "$DSN" -At -c 'select count(*) from "BlogCategory"' -c 'select count(*) from "BlogPost"'
